rules.rule: Every record document rejects duplicate field_id, section_id, and connection_id values even when the complete objects differ.
Proposal changes, diff cards, authority and visibility entries, references, resolutions, and record bindings are unique by their logical identifiers, not by whole-object equality.

Every record document, including record views and every card before/after document, derives authority from status: canon maps to canon, revealed maps to revealed, and every other supported status maps to preparation.

draft, needs_review, rejected, and conflict proposals are not_published with no published revision; approving may be quarantined or not_published with no revision; only approved proposals are published and carry a published revision.

Both action requests carry exact loaded proposal ID/version, revisions, workflow, payload/diff/validation digests, record bindings, impact, authority, and visibility values. The server compares current head and workflow before accepting the action. Approval additionally requires needs_review and passed validation with zero errors.

An accepted non-replay mutation consumes the supplied campaign-wide workflow version exactly once. A proposal returned from version N is stamped N+1; its approval or rejection consumes N+1 and completes at N+2. Exact replay, stale, and failed operations do not increment.

Every authority or visibility difference between a record card's before and after documents has one matching diff outcome, proposal outcome, and explicit approval confirmation ID. An outcome without a corresponding before/after transition is invalid.

Every connection card is derived from exactly one subject record before/after pair. The card set is the exact added, changed, and removed connection delta, so omissions, extras, no-ops, and directionally inconsistent cards fail closed. Cards carry the exact derived backlink effects.

Record digests, property cards, connection and backlink cards, authority and visibility transition entries, affected_record_count, and approval confirmation sets are exact projections of one mutation. No field, section, connection, transition, card subject, or confirmation may be added, removed, or changed independently.

Every removal stage carries the exact impact binding and impact digest. The impact references, resolutions, resolution cards, affected record bindings, and derived backlink or connection effects form exact one-to-one logical mappings. Duplicate reference IDs, missing references, extra references, no-ops, self-redirects, and redirects to non-existent records fail closed.
A removal correction rebinds the exact removal impact document and digest and preserves the prior proposal provenance while creating a new immutable version.
